# read_betas { #falconage.read_betas }

```python
read_betas(path, *, samples_are='auto', obs=None)
```

Read a beta matrix from CSV, TSV or parquet.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Default   |
|-------------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| samples_are | [str](`str`) | ``"rows"``, ``"columns"``, or ``"auto"``. Auto looks at which axis carries probe-shaped identifiers, which is reliable precisely because ``cg`` ids are unmistakable -- guessing from the shape alone would get a 1000-sample 450K matrix right and a 500,000-probe cohort wrong. | `'auto'`  |
